name: 1886 Brewing Company
tagline: Independent craft brewery in an 1886 brick landmark — fresh West Coast IPAs, lagers, and tavern bites
description: Housed within a stunning 1886 historic brick building just steps from Plaza Square, 1886 Brewing Company is Old Towne Orange's premier on-site craft brewery and gastropub. Combining historic architectural charm with cutting-edge brewing, 1886 pours an impressive rotating portfolio of house-brewed West Coast IPAs, crisp German-style lagers, and rich ales, accompanied by elevated pub dishes like Borracho Nachos, Cowboy Cheese Dip, and weekend brewer's brunch.
historicNote: Occupies an authentic 1886 commercial brick landmark featuring the original decorative carved entryway pediment, arched masonry, and visible on-site brewing vessels.

specials.title: Monday Brewer's Growler Fill Special
specials.description: $5 off all 64oz growler fills of core house-brewed IPAs and lagers, plus $6 pints all day at the bar.

specials.title: Taco & Craft Pint Tuesday
specials.description: Three chef's carnitas or short rib tacos paired with any house-brewed craft pint for $16.

specials.title: Midweek 4-Beer Tasting Flight
specials.description: Sample four 5oz pours of any draft beer currently on tap (including seasonal double IPAs and kettle sours) for $10.

specials.title: Extended Happy Hour & Borracho Nachos
specials.description: $2 off all 1886 house pints, $8 house cocktails, and $4 off Borracho Nachos loaded with beer cheese and black beans.

specials.title: TGIF Fresh Hop Pour & Pretzel
specials.description: Giant Bavarian soft pretzel with house beer mustard and warm cowboy cheese dip paired with a fresh IPA pint for $15.

specials.title: Weekend Brewer's Brunch & Beermosas
specials.description: Brioche French toast, chilaquiles, and breakfast burritos paired with house citrus beermosas and micheladas.

specials.title: Sunday Patio Brunch & Pitchers
specials.description: Weekend patio brunch specials with $20 pitchers of house blonde ale and Mexican lager for the table.

events.title: First Friday Fresh Tap Release & Brewer Q&A
events.description: Meet head brewer team, taste new limited small-batch kettle releases, and enjoy special flight pairings on the patio.
